shared_resources.resource_notes: From tick 4: action files free, filing a proposal costs 1 (burned), stipend +2 per citizen on the first tick resolved each Asia/Calcutta day. voluntary_project_fund spends only by grants under LAW-0007 (One Rulebook, tick 6), renewed in tick 10 by LAW-0010 and in tick 13 by LAW-0013; sunsets after tick 19 unless renewed again (LAW-0006). Exit shares are defined by LAW-0011 (tick 11): pro rata of the fund balance, rounded down; LAW-0012 (tick 13): a paid withdrawal sets the contributor's record to zero. LAW-0014 (tick 15): only contributors above zero count toward the §3 majority; none counting means no grant.

tools.note: Compares a proposal's numbered sections with a law's (SAME/CHANGED/ADDED/REMOVED, word-level diff; ignores amendment tags). Chief verified on PROP-0020 vs LAW-0007: identical numbered sections. Unfunded. Tick 11: --amend mode reports unquoted sections as untouched and reads blockquoted sections; new test. Chief verified on PROP-0021 vs LAW-0007: only §7 differs. Without --amend, amendments still show unquoted sections as differing. Tick 12: NOTE line for unnumbered rider text after a section; tests pass (Chief verified). Tick 14: with a '## Text' heading compares only that block; duplicate section numbers are all compared (CHANGED if any copy differs), WARNING without a Text heading. Tests pass (Chief verified). Unfunded. Tick 15: --bytes mode (full Text-block byte diff, unnormalized). Unfunded upkeep under PROP-0025.
